game.name: Dodonpachi Resurrection (Europe)
game.desc: DoDonPachi Resurrection is a shoot'em up developed for the arcade and then adapted for the Xbox 360. It is a manic shooter, meaning a title in which enemy fire can cover most of the screen. This Xbox 360 version offers three new modes compared to the original game: Novice mode, which is ideal for getting to grips with the game, Arrange A mode and Arrange B mode, both of which offer very specific scoring systems.
